value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task commands opening the door before picking up the box. Add a hard Existence(door_open); keep the stated order. The soft Absence(key_lost) correctly captures “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.”

Remove that Existence clause. Keep the soft Absence(key_lost), which matches “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed,” and the target goal and order clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the soft Absence(key_lost) captures “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed,” and hard Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) requires picking up the box after opening the door.

texts: Prefer not to lose the matching key while the door is closed.
Pick up the box in the other room.
Open the door before picking up the box.
